name: Black Rider (VST3)
description: An analogue monosynth sitting between the MS-20 and the Moog. Two oscillators you can push into instability, drift and injection-lock, and one filter with three circuits on a switch — two Sallen-Key tempers and a transistor ladder, all three in tune when they scream. An eight-cable patch bay on a wing that folds out of the side, including the MS-20 trick of patching the amplifier back into the filter. Two hundred seed patches on a red LED dial.
note: Windows VST3 · build 261024.3 · free download · 200 seed patches · 18-page manual.
